name: Front-loaded Alberta $50B (uncalibrated diagnostic)
description: A counterfactual structural stress test that holds total investment, component mix and local capture equal to the staggered reference while concentrating 67% of capital expenditure in the first five years. It is not a forecast or an aggregation of announced projects.
normalization_note: The reference scenario's uncalibrated annual Alberta absorption denominators are held constant so this variant isolates timing concentration.
capture_note: The 0.72 uniform local-capture assumption is held equal to the staggered reference; it is not an observed retention rate.
exclusion_note: Computing and networking plus professional and other costs total 54% of scenario capex and are not propagated through the construction graph.
author: AIIO Canada research build
